rca of the issue: TradecheckMarketplace.jsx imported MarketingLayout as default export from @/components/marketing/Layout, but that file only has named exports (MarketingNav, MarketingFooter). Webpack compile error 'export default not found' caused the entire React app to render a red error overlay on every dashboard route, blocking all UI testing of Batch (d). Reproduction: navigate to any /dashboard/* route — overlay covers the page even though sidebar/page DOM is technically rendered behind it. Mitigation applied: changed import to `import { MarketingNav, MarketingFooter } from '@/components/marketing/Layout'` and replaced `<MarketingLayout>...</MarketingLayout>` wrapper with `<><MarketingNav/>...<MarketingFooter/></>`. Long-term fix: main agent should add a default-export MarketingLayout component to @/components/marketing/Layout.jsx so the original ergonomic API works for future pages.
